restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Taco Bamba says corn tortillas are naturally gluten free but the kitchen has shared fryers and prep space and is not a gluten-free facility; serious-allergy guests should ask before ordering.

The official Vienna page links location allergen information and instructs customers to use the guide; the linked document's location label was not treated as sufficient to assert unsupported item-level negatives for Vienna.
